reason: A static runner/executor audit found that multiple tool calls emitted in one assistant turn were executed sequentially, allowing a later dependent call to use executor state created by an earlier call even though the model had not yet observed that earlier tool result.

corrections.change: issue at most one tool call per assistant turn and wait for the tool observation before any later dependent call
only call_index=0 is execution_allowed; later same-turn calls are recorded but cannot execute
execution_allowed=false returns parallel_tool_call_requires_observation and never advances deterministic task state
the follow-up message must contain INV-NEW-1 from the inventory.create observation; mentioning only the user-supplied item name is insufficient

unchanged: required route sets and task kinds
candidate ranking/K values and lexical ordering
phase_a_note: This amendment changes only downstream B1 execution causality. Phase A retrieval changes only because of the separate explicit-user-argument task-text correction.
required_next_steps: pass regression tests for same-turn dependency blocking
rerun Phase A and record the actual corrected task SHA and Recall@K
freeze B1 preregistration v2 including the one-call-per-turn observation barrier
run only new B1 episode sources after preregistration v2
provenance_note: This correction was made from static causal-semantics audit before any accepted complete B1 aggregate and was not selected from task-success outcomes.
